title: Types Of Public Sector Enterprises
definition: Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) in India are business undertakings owned, managed, and controlled by the Central Government, State Governments, or both, aimed at socio-economic development, infrastructure creation, and strategic control of the economy.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims (criteria for Maharatna, Navratna, Miniratna status, financial autonomy) and Mains GS Paper III (role of PSUs in economic development, privatization, disinvestment policies, and corporate governance).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Types Of Public Sector Enterprises.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian Industrial Policy 1956
